rows.grounds: token 0; read as samastā in the phrase samastābhīṣṭasiddhiḥ, indicating totality of desired accomplishments
token 1; first member of compound bhīṣṭa-siddhiḥ, denoting what is wished for
token 2; head of compound bhīṣṭa-siddhiḥ, denoting fulfillment or success
token 3; form of as, expressing the wish or result that accomplishment may occur
token 4; sandhi for śrāvaṇe māsi, specifying the time as the month of Śrāvaṇa
token 5; indicates uninterrupted or constant occurrence
